run_compress_text: run compress_text.py to generate a binary reference file with byte offsets for each sentence in an input text file
create_index_create: create a FAISS FlatL2 index from a torch tensor file and save it to disk
load_text_simple: load a text file into a Python list of stripped sentence strings
index_text_open: open a text file and its reference offset file as memory-mapped arrays for fast sentence retrieval
index_search_knn: search the k nearest neighbors of query vectors in a FAISS index and return the corresponding text lines
